subject: Kickoff: genomics OOD detection (likelihood ratios)
body:
Hi Deshawn,

Kicking off the genomics OOD workstream officially. Goal: turn our open-source likelihood-ratio OOD work into a contamination-screening feature for the sequencing partners in the health-science portfolio. The method pairs an autoregressive LSTM generative model over DNA sequences with a ConvNet classifier, and flags inputs via a likelihood ratio against a background model - that is the piece partners cannot get from an off-the-shelf classifier.

Proposed milestones: repro the bacteria benchmark (10 in-distribution classes, 60 OOD validation classes, before-2011 training split) by May 29; internal eval review June 19; LRB pre-read week of July 13. Nikhil leads modeling, Yara owns evals, Halima owns data plumbing.

Can you confirm staffing and send a compute estimate by Friday?

Thanks,
Viktor
